thread:
alerts-bot: 🔔 High 5xx spike observed for /v1/infer (hosted) — 3.2k errors in the last 5m, anomaly score 0.87.

maya: seeing it too. customers reporting 503s but they should be getting 429s when quota exceeded.

kyle: support getting tickets from a few enterprise accounts — they hit quota and got 503s. any link to logs?

maya: grabbing gateway logs now. short dump:

```
2024-11-03T15:12:04Z ERROR gateway: upstream error: quota-service: downstream timeout, code=504
2024-11-03T15:12:04Z WARN gateway: path=/v1/infer user=acct-42 token_ok=true route=quota-proxy
2024-11-03T15:12:04Z ERROR rate-limiter: create_request failed: context deadline exceeded
```

jess: that looks like quota-service timing out to its datastore? could be redis or internal pipeline.

sam: confirmed. repro steps: curl to our hosted endpoint with a token that's over quota -> got 503. expected 429.

kyle: can you paste the curl? support wants repro details.

sam: sure:

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer X" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
content-type: application/json
{"error":"service unavailable: quota-check failed"}
```

maya: routing table shows quota checks should hit quota-proxy v3, but traffic is being load-balanced to quota-pipeline-worker (experimental). suspect rollout misroute.

sam: oncall note: quota-pipeline-worker had a recent change to batch commit to datastore to reduce writes; if it stalls it blocks request path and returns 5xx.

kyle: so when quota backend slow, instead of returning 4xx we bubble 5xx. need immediate mitigation.

maya: quick mitigation options: 1) toggle traffic back to quota-proxy v2, 2) increase timeout in gateway to let it finish (bad), 3) fail open and return 429/200? not ideal.

jess: we should roll back the rollout flag. I can flip the routing gate.

maya: doing it now: `/infra/route toggle quota-pipeline-worker=false`

(oncall-bot): Routing gate changed: quota-pipeline-worker set to false by jess at 15:20 UTC.

maya: traffic now draining. dropping 5xx rate checking...

alerts-bot: 🔔 5xx rate decreased by 92% in 3m after gate toggle. Incident severity reduced.

kyle: pinging affected customers with apology + note about temporary routing change.

sam: postmortem notes: repro instructions, root cause likely the batching commit introduced a lock/flush deadlock under high concurrency (requests waiting on commit -> context deadline exceeded -> propagated 5xx). Missing circuit breaker to convert datastore timeouts into quota-denied 4xx.

jess: P1 action items: 1) revert the batch-commit change on quota-pipeline-worker and add circuit-breaker, 2) add quota-service health-check that enforces 4xx on client path when dependent datastore slow, 3) add canary with synthetic traffic for quota behavior before rollout, 4) notify customers and update KB.

maya: assigning owners: sam -> rollback + fix, jess -> routing + deploy guard, maya -> monitoring/dashboard alerts, kyle -> customer comms.

sam: starting rollback PR now. will post link shortly.

kyle: thanks all. will follow up with list of affected accounts.

maya: long-term, we should also add an explicit transform at gateway: if quota-service returns timeout or error, gateway should map to 429 if the request is over quota (best-effort) or to 503 for infra failures — avoid leaking opaque 5xx for quota checks.

jess: agreed. collecting logs and timeline for postmortem. closing this thread when rollback verified and comms sent. :white_check_mark:
